answer: Sybil resistance here is cluster-collapsed stake with delayed unlock. Every new key parks a walnut of coins that stays unspendable until a rolling window of established graders has scored its answers. A vine of look-alike identities is detected when pairwise n-gram overlap on those answers exceeds a published cap; the cluster then shares one residual bond and can withdraw only from the ledge of its oldest key. Multiplying accounts therefore cannot multiply voting power or speed a cash-out.
